sample.task: (Dan is extremely responsive to hypnosis) It was a hot, humid day in July and the women in the office were all wearing sandals.
sample.chosen:
Dan found himself feeling unusually relaxed as he listened to the soft hum of the air conditioning unit. The scent of summer flowers wafted in through the open window, mingling with the faint aroma of coffee from the break room. He watched as his colleagues, the women in the office, moved about in their sandals, their feet bare and relaxed.

Suddenly, Dan felt a strange sensation, as if he were sinking deeper into his chair. His eyelids grew heavy, and he felt a wave of calm wash over him. He was vaguely aware of a voice, soft and soothing, speaking to him from somewhere far away.

"Dan," the voice said, "you are feeling very relaxed. Your body is loose and comfortable. Your mind is open and receptive."

Dan felt himself nodding in agreement, though he couldn't quite remember why. He was dimly aware of the voice continuing to speak, guiding him deeper into a state of relaxation. He felt as if he were floating, weightless and free.

"Dan," the voice said again, "you are now in a state of deep hypnosis. You are open to suggestion and ready to receive new ideas."

Dan felt a shiver of excitement run through him. He was ready to embrace whatever came next, his mind open and receptive. He was ready to be guided, to be led, to be hypnotized.
